output: {"objective":"Find the molecular mechanism that best explains the loss of function of WAS-p.Thr45Met (WAS, UniProt P42768) and test it with one targeted computational test.","subject":{"gene":"WAS","variant_id":"WAS-p.Thr45Met","accession":"P42768","position":45,"reference_residue":"T","alternate_residue":"M","protein_change":"p.Thr45Met"},"events":68,"current_favourite":"H2","hypotheses":[{"id":"H1","mechanism_class":"protein_interaction","starting_rank":1,"statement":"The Thr45Met substitution sits in the WH1/EVH1 domain and removes a contact needed for WASp to bind its partner WIP, weakening the WASp–WIP complex and the downstream proline-rich-ligand recognition that depends on it.","supports":["E5","E6","E16","E10","E15","E7","E9"],"would_refute":"If residue 45 is solvent-exposed and more than about 10 Å from the WIP-binding surface in PDB 9S9X and in a WASp–WIP model, and the Met substitution does not change the predicted WIP interface contacts or binding energy, the hypothesis is refuted.","latest_verdict":"unchanged","label":"agent-generated hypothesis"},{"id":"H2","mechanism_class":"stability_folding","starting_rank":2,"statement":"The Thr45Met substitution destabilises the EVH1/WH1 fold, lowering folding stability and cellular WASp levels, so that little functional protein accumulates.","supports":["E15","E12","E14","E7","E8","E9","E2"],"would_refute":"If residue 45 is buried in the high-confidence core of AF-P42768-F1 or 9S9X and a stability predictor gives a near-zero ΔΔG for T45M, and the Met side chain fits without clashes in the model, the destabilisation mechanism is refuted.","latest_verdict":"supported","label":"agent-generated hypothesis"}],"results":[{"test_id":"T1","test_kind":"stability_effect","summary":"FoldX predicted ΔΔG for T45M on the AlphaFold model AF-P42768-F1 is +3.56 kcal/mol, above the 2.0 kcal/mol destabilising threshold (ProtVar display bins), with residue pLDDT 96.62. The within-site control, T45R, gave ΔΔG +7.43 kcal/mol under the same predictor. The applicability control (pLDDT 96.62) indicates the residue is confidently modelled, so the FoldX value is interpretable.","headline":"FoldX predicts ΔΔG +3.56 kcal/mol for T45M, at or above the destabilising threshold of 2.0 kcal/mol.","verdict":"predicted_destabilising","job_id":null},{"test_id":"T2","test_kind":"structural_context","summary":"Residue 45 lies in 2 of the ProtVar predicted pockets (pocket 5: score 572.2, buriedness 0.74, mean pLDDT 84.0; pocket 27: score 271.2, buriedness 0.79, mean pLDDT 85.4) and in none of the 1 P2Rank pocket on the AlphaFold model AF-P42768-F1. ProtVar reports residue 45 in no predicted protein-protein interface (in_predicted_interface: false). Controls: the P2Rank pocket count was 1 with no residue-45 hit, and the pocket confidence control gave mean pLDDT 84.0 and 85.4 for the two ProtVar pockets.","headline":"Residue 45: lines none of the 1 P2Rank pockets; lies in 2 ProtVar predicted pocket(s); lies in no predicted protein-protein interface (ProtVar).","verdict":"in_predicted_pocket","job_id":null}]}
